intro: The direct quotation reproduces words attributed to a source; the paraphrase sums up its meaning without presenting it as a literal quotation.

bloques.titulo: The direct quotation reproduces words attributed to a source; the paraphrase sums up its meaning without presenting it as a literal quotation.
texto: The direct quotation reproduces words attributed to a source; the paraphrase sums up its meaning without presenting it as a literal quotation.
Colours, verbs of attribution and reference should allow the reader to distinguish the position from the source from that of the editor.

frases.es: El director declaró: «El nuevo edificio abrirá en otoño».
frases.en: The director stated: «The new building will open in the fall».

frases.ru: Позже пресс-служба сообщила, что сроки пока не изменились.
frases.es: Más tarde, el servicio de prensa comunicó que las fechas todavía no habían cambiado.
frases.en: The press service later reported that the dates had not changed yet.

opciones.explicacion: The quotes present the statement as a direct quote.
